summary: Swvl Holdings Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about HSBC increasing its working capital facility by 110% to $1.4 million and adopting HSBC's global payment solutions in Egypt. The facility, originally established in November 2024, will fund working capital for enterprise contracts across Egypt, GCC, UK, and US. The filing also notes Egypt revenue growth of 20% in FY 2025 and 45% YoY in Q1 2026. This is a routine business update regarding a credit facility expansion, not a special situation. The filing incorporates portions into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. No deal terms, M&A activity, or corporate restructuring are involved.
